font.reason: Lalezar is a single-weight heavy poster face, the equivalent of Helvetica 800 for the giant outlined headline; no fake bold used. Vazirmatn variable is neutral UI for the method label and status tags (700/800). Both loaded via FaFonts so no frame falls back.

comps.translatedSummary: Title 'ALIVE' -> «زنده»; label 'LINE BOIL' -> «جوشش خط»; tags 'boil on/off' -> «جوشش روشن» / «جوشش خاموش».

rtlDecisions.why: Header anchor follows reading start: insetInlineStart:120 puts it top-right.
insetInlineEnd:72 puts it bottom-left, keeping diagonal balance with the label.

rtlDecisions.what: Outlined card contents (placeholder lines, avatar circle + line row)
rtlDecisions.why: direction:rtl makes lines start at the right edge and the circle sit at the right, as text lines do in Persian UI.

rtlDecisions.what: Centered title and card, feTurbulence seed floor(f/3), baseFrequency, scale 8, filter region, boil phases 35-105
rtlDecisions.why: Symmetric composition; noise displacement is physical and applies to the whole layer (never per letter, so Persian joining is safe). Timing/seed untouched.

Set to 0 everywhere; they break Persian joining. Title size 170 -> 230 (Lalezar compact, small x-height); label/tag sizes via fs() x1.1; title box height fixed at 170 so the card keeps its original vertical position.

rasterTextHandling: None: pure CSS/SVG, no raster assets.
